proposals.evidence: DEDR4411 big and5159 river both document Gondi berel/berer/bereḍ river and beriar flood/river in flood; the same big + river formation is explicitly segmented in Parji per-ed. Propose the corresponding ordered components for these Gondi ber-/bher- river responses. Their aspiration, rhotic/lateral and final-vowel differences remain intact; this is a comparative compound analysis across the survey lects, not a literal dictionary claim for every spelling.
